program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def orbit(r, c):
        return [(r, c), (c, n - 1 - r), (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                (n - 1 - c, r), (r, n - 1 - c), (n - 1 - r, c),
                (c, r), (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(len(grid[r])):
            if grid[r][c] == 2:
                known = [grid[a][b] for a, b in orbit(r, c) if grid[a][b] != 2]
                out[r][c] = known[0]
    return out
'''
